title: Many alignment techniques work by training one model and deploying another
summary: tl;dr - Steering vectors, inoculation prompting, and post-hoc honesty fine-tuning can all be understood as variants of one alignment strategy, which I call train-deploy mismatch. Each trains the model in one configuration and deploys it in another.
